briefdescription.para: Configure an LPD glitch detector via lpd_slcr GD registers.

parameterdescription.para: is the minimum voltage glitch detection depth (5 bits)
is the minimum glitch detector width (4 bits)
is the reference voltage (4 bits)
is the LPD glitch detector number (0 or 1)

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS on success.
XLOADER_ERR_LPD_GD_FIELD_LEN_EXCEEDED if GdNum/Depth/Width/RefVoltage exceed permitted field lengths
XLOADER_ERR_LPD_GD_RESET_FAILED if failed to assert/release LPD GD
XLOADER_ERR_LPD_GD_VAL_SEL_WRITE_FAILED if the VAL_SEL write failed
XLOADER_ERR_LPD_GD_COMP_SEL_WRITE_FAILED if the COMP_SEL write failed
XLOADER_ERR_LPD_GD_DEL_SEL_WRITE_FAILED if the DEL_SEL write failed
XLOADER_ERR_LPD_GD_SPARE_SEL_WRITE_FAILED if the SPARE_SEL write failed

simplesect.para: Two apertures are touched here and both are write protected. The calibration registers are in lpd_slcr, guarded by lpd_slcr.wprot0, and RST_RPU_GD_0/RST_RPU_GD_1 are in psx_crl, guarded by psx_crl.wprot. Both settings are saved, cleared and restored. Like the ASU detector, the LPX detectors come out of POR with their reset register at 0x3, so calibration is bracketed by an assert/release; without the release the block stays in reset and never reports a glitch.
